lede: The biggest thing on the board this week is San Miguel County's Planning Commission sitting down Wednesday with the BOCC for a joint work session on an Affordable Housing Code Update — policy still being written in real time, with a lot at stake for how and where housing gets built here. That same day, the County BOCC holds public hearings on waiving land use fees for Mountain Village's Ilium Valley affordable housing project and a lot line adjustment in Lawson Hill. Telluride Town Council meets Tuesday with a public hearing on a vesting period extension and a work session on automated license plate reader cameras — a conversation that tends to matter more than it sounds.
